export_chat_explain.message: Exports this chat as a zip archive: a static HTML viewer that looks like the message list, a plain-text transcript, the raw message data and the media files. Read receipts, full HTML e-mail contents and webxdc app contents are not included.

slothful_welcome_message.message:
🦥 A few things work differently here.

SlothfulChat is an independent fork of Delta Chat — not directly affiliated with it, and not a repackaged copy. The most unusual part: it runs entirely in your web browser. The whole chat core is compiled to WebAssembly, so there is nothing to install and no server that holds your account — your messages, keys and files live in this browser, on this device. On a phone you can still add it to your home screen and use it like any other app.

Because your data lives in the browser, it can also vanish with it: clearing site data, a browser cleanup or private-browsing mode wipes everything. Please export a backup (Settings → Chats → Export Backup) and keep it somewhere safe — backups here are not encrypted, so guard the file like your private key.

This is also a prototyping ground for the developers: features land early, and some of them change or break. If something looks different from Delta Chat, that is usually on purpose.

slothful_welcome_contact_developer.message: Found a bug or something that feels wrong? Tell us directly — New Chat → "Sloth (Slothful.chat Developer)".

slothful_welcome_selfhost.message: And it's yours to run: host your own instance, or fork it and change whatever you like 👉 https://github.com/experintellia/slothfulchat-web
